capabilities: create Excel-like spreadsheets inside the vault
embed spreadsheets and charts in notes
create charts and interactive dashboards from sheet data
validate data with checkboxes, dropdowns, and dates
automate spreadsheet processing through a REST API with AI agents
disambiguation: Not a Markdown table editor; it creates full spreadsheet documents that are embedded into notes.
extras: Freemium: import/export, dashboards, kanban, calendar views, and agent integrations require a license. Full user guide is hosted externally (user guide and YouTube channel), and support runs through Discord, email, and GitHub Issues.
problem: Obsidian has no native spreadsheet support, so users working with tabular data must leave the vault or settle for plain Markdown tables.

relations.evidence: A full-featured spreadsheet experience, built on Univer, directly inside your Obsidian vault.

requires.name: AI agent tools such as DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, Claudian

summary: Spreadsheet plugin that creates Excel-like sheets on Univer and embeds them in notes with charts, validation, and xlsx import/export.
